g.text: BurcinCo.BurcinApp - End-to-End Request and Service Interactions
HTTP request at a process boundary
AppHost starts and wires selected resources but is not part
of either runtime path. In development, its MAUI targets are
explicit-start resources. The generated Web and MAUI shells
currently render UI only; neither issues an application API call.
The API caller represents external consumers today and the
Product UI HTTP-adapter seam when application data access is added.
All Product UI API traffic enters through Gateway, never Host directly.
Queue-backed Gateway Webhook processing (when --Sample is generated)
«validate» valid JSON body at most 1 MiB
HTTP 202 confirms broker routing only; Host-side business
processing has not completed. Invalid, oversized, failed, or
unrouted publications return HTTP 400, 413, or 502 instead.
Concurrent conflicts use bounded exponential retry with jitter.
Deliveries that exceed the finite attempt count are dead-lettered.
OData write and cross-module validation (when --Sample is generated and Nutrition is active)
Recipe is active in the same Host
Recipe runs in a separate Host deployment
This supported deployment branch requires an overlay; the default
AppHost does not create a second Host resource. Configure
RecipeClientSettings.BaseAddress for the split Recipe Host.
